mapper.sql: select i.id, i.vm_id, i.sku_id, i.channel_id, i.current_stock, i.min_stock, i.max_stock, i.last_supply_time, i.create_time, i.update_time, vm.inner_code, s.sku_name, s.sku_image, c.channel_code from tb_inventory i left join tb_vending_machine vm on i.vm_id = vm.id left join tb_sku s on i.sku_id = s.sku_id left join tb_channel c on i.channel_id = c.id
mapper.select: where i.vm_id = #{vmId} and i.sku_id = #{skuId} and i.channel_id = #{channelId}
where i.current_stock = i.min_stock order by i.current_stock asc
where i.current_stock < i.min_stock order by i.current_stock asc
